author: Mainframe Games
name: Mainframe Engine game
description: A game project for the Mainframe Engine: a class library for your nodes (MyGame), a launcher that runs it with GameHost (MyGame.Launcher), project.mfproj and Content/.

EngineSource.description: How the game references the engine.

choices.description: Project references into an engine checkout (--engine-path). Works today.
The MainframeEngine NuGet package (--engine-version). Future: the package is not published yet.

EnginePath.description: Path of the engine checkout (the folder holding MainframeEngine.sln); absolute, or relative to the new project folder.

EngineVersion.description: Engine version recorded in project.mfproj (and the package version with --engine-source package).
